text_block_list.text:
Our company!! My company!! Your company!! 
YOUR RESPECTED COMPANY!!!

With the sheer zeal of a hardcore 
salesman, Gold Ship defeated Tosen Jordan. 
On top of that, she acquired a brand-new 
keyword.

The two promise to battle again on a grand 
stage. However, the mystery surrounding 
the keyword, the sender— and Eden 
itself—only deepens.

At that moment, cheers erupted from the 
venue celebrating Gold Ship's back-to-back 
Takarazuka Kinen victories. The Trainer 
also rejoiced at the incredible feat.
choice_data_list: It's so amazing, it'll go down in history

text_block_list.text:
In high spirits from this, Gold Ship 
bought red-and-white steamed buns on the 
way home and decided to share just the 
skin with the Trainer. Just the skin...

A proud Gold Ship wasn't satisfied with 
just that—she demanded even more praise 
from her Trainer. What a cutie!

This fired Gold Ship right up. Determined 
to make things even hotter next year, she 
got motivated enough to burn down the 
starting gate. Please don't!
